title: sys_organization zh-CN: the `logo` field is labelled 「标识」, which reads as the identifier (slug) on the same page: label it 「徽标」
body:
Filing gate ①: class (a), reproduced through a public door. Found by the cloud os-dev reading on objectstack-ai/cloud#3000 (comment `6383481767`): the 「重命名组织」 dialog on a zh-CN console, objectui `fb25620e`, framework pin `f0fdd45bbc83`. Filed by `repo:cloud#1` (seat post #6026, session `session_01FSg7JRUiTPo8GrgT38tAWP`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the objectstack lane that owns `platform-objects` translations.

## Measured
- The organization record page labels the slug 「标识符」 (`change_slug`).
- Directly above it, the `rename_organization` dialog labels its `logo` param 「标识」, with placeholder `https://example.com`. A reader takes it for the identifier.
- **Source:** the zh-CN bundle `sys_organization.fields.logo.label = 标识` (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.objects.generated.ts`, around line 535 at the pin). The file is generated, so the fix belongs at its source.

## Wanted
- The zh-CN label for `sys_organization.fields.logo` reads 「徽标」 (or 「Logo」), fixed at the generated file's source.
- Check ja-JP for the same collision.

## Acceptance
The generated bundle reads the new label. The rename dialog's logo param is no longer 「标识」.

## Dedupe
`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack sys_organization logo 标识` was searched; none was found.
